details:
Please consider adding native support for bone-driven eyelid animation to VRChat's Face Tracking system.

Currently, eyelid tracking primarily relies on blendshapes ("EyeClosedLeft", "EyeClosedRight"). However, some avatar rigs use dedicated eyelid bones instead of blendshapes.

Eye gaze tracking is already working correctly on my avatar. The eyeball bones respond to eye tracking as expected. The missing piece is the ability to drive separate eyelid bones using face tracking data.

Proposed Functionality

Add an optional Bone-Based eyelid mode alongside the existing blendshape-based mode.

The system should allow avatar creators to:

- Assign separate bones for the left and right eyelids.

- Configure open and closed rotations for each eyelid bone.

- Optionally configure additional rotations for looking up and down.

- Drive eyelid bones using existing Unified Expressions tracking inputs, such as "EyeClosedLeft" and "EyeClosedRight".

Proposed Rig Structure

The following is an example of how a bone-based rig could be configured:

Avatar Head

│

├── Left Eye

│   └── Eyeball Bone

│       └── Controlled by eye gaze tracking

│

├── Right Eye

│   └── Eyeball Bone

│       └── Controlled by eye gaze tracking

│

├── Left Eyelid

│   └── Eyelid Bone(s)

│       └── Controlled by EyeClosedLeft

│

└── Right Eyelid

    └── Eyelid Bone(s)

        └── Controlled by EyeClosedRight

Expected Tracking Behavior

Unified Expressions

│

├── Eye Gaze

│   ├── EyeLookUpLeft / Right

│   ├── EyeLookDownLeft / Right

│   ├── EyeLookInLeft / Right

│   └── EyeLookOutLeft / Right

│       └── Drives eyeball bone rotation

│

└── Eyelid Tracking

    ├── EyeClosedLeft

    │   └── Drives left eyelid bone rotation

    │

    └── EyeClosedRight

        └── Drives right eyelid bone rotation

Independent Eye and Eyelid Control

An important requirement is keeping eye gaze and eyelid movement independent.

For example:

- Eye gaze tracking should continue controlling the eyeball bones.

- Blink tracking should independently control the eyelid bones.

- Closing one eye should not affect the other.

- Enabling or configuring eyelid animation should not disable eye gaze tracking.

- Both systems should be able to operate simultaneously on separate bones.

Optionally, eyelid bones could also support additional movement based on eye gaze direction, allowing eyelids to naturally follow the eyes when looking up or down.

Compatibility

Ideally, this would be an additional option rather than a replacement for the existing blendshape workflow. Existing avatars should remain unaffected.

This would allow avatars using bone-based facial rigs to use native VRChat Face Tracking without requiring custom Animator workarounds or converting their rigs to blendshapes.

Thank you for considering this feature!
title: [Feature Request] Bone-Based Eyelid Tracking Support
